purpose: Materialize a new 1..60 target identity from original OANDA decimal bid/ask opens, correcting exact-zero signs while preserving the original target archive.
source_window: 2024-05-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive; chunk ending 2026-01-03 physically contains later development but only pre-2026 prices are selected.
method: Bind all original source chunk hashes and canonical 2024/2025 float prices; derive exact common-grid midpoint sums from decimal strings and require recovered integer bid/ask sides to round-trip both floats and source midpoint sums. Generate move, bps and sign from the integer grid.
validation: Retain exact original parents, clocks, source rows and observed masks; reproduce all 60 independent sign-confusion matrices for the full scope and both fold1 populations; require 976 false moves removed and zero opposing nonzero signs. Roundtrip the new archive and retain old files.
limits: New target identity only, no model fit or prediction update. Current training routes still require a separately bound corrected target contract, new initial baseline and new admission. No TEST, broker, order, live/paper or economic edge.
